items.difficulty_reason: Approximation by perfect complexes propagates across elementary distinguished squares: constructs r = max(r_U, r') with the reduced-subspace structure on T' and the quasi-compactness of V \ j^{-1}(T'), then proves by induction on the top degree t: base case via approximation on V and the open lemma; induction step glues an approximation P on U with a lifted perfect Q on V (schemes lift lemmas through the epsilon equivalence and pseudo-coherence/perfectness translation), glues the maps by lemma-glue into R -> E, forms the cone E', and closes with the TR3 morphism of triangles and two-out-of-three perfectness.
